verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own Merchant of Record add-on manages sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for each sale, with Airwallex acting as legal seller. However, it is beta with limited eligibility and covers digital products only. There is no documented standalone tax-calculation or collection feature for merchants outside MoR. Missing for 10: tax calculation for physical goods and non-MoR merchants, general availability beyond beta, documentation of how rates are computed and shown per transaction, independent or hands-on corroboration.
